create_ArraySpec: create an ArraySpec with a given shape and numpy dtype for describing array contracts
validate_ArraySpec: validate a numpy array against an ArraySpec to check shape and dtype conformance
generate_ArraySpec_value: generate a zero-filled test numpy array that conforms to an ArraySpec shape and dtype
create_BoundedArraySpec: create a BoundedArraySpec with shape, dtype, and minimum and maximum value bounds
validate_BoundedArraySpec: validate a numpy array against a BoundedArraySpec to check shape, dtype, and value bounds
